reviews.reason: CodeTemplatesTab 拥有模板表和代码 studio，studio session 捕获 starting revision，后台刷新不覆盖未保存 source。 职责属于同一资源或组件生命周期，独立草稿/异步状态没有应合为单一字段的不变量；同步 setters 由 React19 batching，行数或 setter 数本身不能证明额外 render。 P21b reassessed 2026-11-17: ComponentRecordsTab changes only icon leaf imports. Its ordered trim/filter normalization, named filter/empty slots and record editor states retain the same owner. UiCodeTemplateStudio now takes resourceKind for block/template permissions and document paths while retaining independent source/config/preview drafts and close/open snapshot reset. API and panel witnesses propagate this resource kind. CodeTemplatesTab keeps cached rows on background failure and presents first-load errors through its status ReactNode slot; route navigation still has extracted mutation/tree/editor owners. Mixed native-output/image reason stays held.

Route tests retain failure/retry, readonly access, search, editing and pending-write behavior. SettingsSectionSurface.status and toolbar are explicitly typed ReactNode and rendered directly in named layout regions. loadError is the intended Alert/retry content for the status slot, with its retry button bound to the current query. It is an element tree, not a render-local component type or an effect resource identity. The table retains cached templates during failed background refresh and is withheld for a first failed request; UI-management template tests assert failure versus empty data, retry recovery and retained cached rows. Reassessed 2026-11-03 against the receiver and actual call site.
